name: Mashiba Takumi
source:
Star Sign: Aquarius
Special Skill/Hobby: Window Shopping, Billiards
Favorite Food: Fried Chili Shrimp
Disliked Food: Natto, Sticky Food

A member of CUE and a researcher in the S.A.D.F.
A skillful guy who is popular with the ladies, he even has his own fan-club.
He always seems to not take things seriously but...
He's been childhood friends with [url=/c40227]You[/url] since elementary school. He always supports him.
